name: w13_space_board
_comment: Wave 13 item 3 (P1 with registered hits, run 2: disable and board in view of the police): Enter Ship in Kit Police Range with the Kit Long Beam (pilot w13_p1_beam), recording from the start; hand-driven steps (loops/interactive.mjs) until {done}: target a Kit Shipping, beam it (registered hits on the target panel), watch the police; then loops/board.mjs walks to the DISABLED ship by its grey brackets and boards it (the plunder dialog's Abort is clicked); then hand-driven again (land, leave, pull).
